OPEN-SOURCE AI MEMORY INFRASTRUCTURE

AI memory, with its evidence attached.

MESA is open-source memory infrastructure for AI systems. It keeps information connected to its sources, relationships, and authorized data scope.

Inspect a memory exampleExplore the architecture

WHY MESA

Memory needs more than recall.

  • Keep the source.Useful context needs a traceable basis.
  • Keep the relationships.Relevant text can lose its connections.
  • Keep the boundary.Memory belongs to an authorized scope.

Core brings evidence, structure, scope, and lifecycle state into one memory contract.

HOW MEMORY WORKS

From source to usable context.

Memory has a lifecycle: information is admitted, retrieved within scope, and returned with its evidence.

  1. 01SourceExact source material and identity
  2. 02RememberCore admits scoped memory and keeps evidence
  3. 03RetrieveAuthorized signals are rank-fused
  4. 04Verify & useProvenance and scope travel with context

SQLite owns canonical decisions. LanceDB and Kùzu are derived projections.

How MESA works

THE ECOSYSTEM

One memory layer. Distinct roles.

Compatible sources and preparation feed Core. Applications consume its versioned interfaces.

  1. INPUTSources & preparation
  2. MEMORYMESA Core
  3. OUTPUTApplications
